findings.summary: The definition of drift lost its formulation.

evidence.baseline: This is ideological drift: the process by which a founding commitment becomes a founding myth, honored in the telling, ignored in the operation.
evidence.shipped: Ideological drift begins when a commitment becomes a slogan. Participants repeat the language while daily practice rewards something else.

findings.diagnosis: Honored in the telling, ignored in the operation is the phrase the volume returns to whenever it names this failure, and it is the kind of exact formulation the card protects under earned repetition. The shipped definition is accurate and generic. Founding commitment to founding myth is also a sharper movement than commitment to slogan, because a myth is honoured and a slogan is merely repeated.

findings.summary: The accommodation argument, which is the chapter's most useful sentence, was deleted.

evidence.baseline: As the institution grows, there will be participants for whom this work is more than they signed up for, and there will be organizational pressures to accommodate them by softening the requirements. The accommodation is individually reasonable. Cumulatively, it is catastrophic.
evidence.shipped: Growth increases the temptation to soften demanding principles for convenience or broader appeal.

findings.diagnosis: Individually reasonable and cumulatively catastrophic is the mechanism, and it is the same structure the co-optation chapter uses twenty chapters later. The two beat close is a landing the paragraph earns. Temptation is also a weaker account than pressure, because a temptation implies a person who could resist and a pressure implies a structure that does not care.

findings.summary: Credit, running the other way. The kept closing test is the best sentence in the section and it is the prior pass's.

reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Two em dashes. One introduced the definition of drift and became a colon. One was parenthetical and became a comma pair.

The shipped consent sentence, that refusal must remain possible without retaliation, and the shipped closing test that a principle becomes constitutional only when a participant can identify a breach and seek a remedy without depending on the goodwill of the person in breach. The second is the best sentence in the section and is not in the baseline.
The drift definition with its formulation, the demandingness paragraph, the accommodation argument and its two beat close, and the rotation example with its indispensability clause.

openQuestions: The volume-04 voice card was prepared by the same pass that produced the shipped text, and its exemplar anchors and protected lines quote that text rather than the baseline. The card records `Author approved: pending tone, strategy, heading, and overcompression review`. The restoration keeps every line the card protects and otherwise follows the baseline, which means card and source now diverge in wording the card does not name. R-VOICE-BIND requires that the disagreement be raised rather than settled here: the card should be re-derived from whichever text the author approves.

Structural labels were frozen for this pass and none was touched. Every markdown heading, every standalone bold display line, every chapter label, and every all-capital display line is byte identical to its pre-edit state, in the same order, with the same blank-line separators on both sides. A label determines a section id, a section id is a public route, and `publishing/continuity/section-lineage.json` already records this volume's renames and resolves the historical routes. Changing one is a continuity decision and not an editorial one. Only the running prose between labels was restored. Where a baseline label names its section better than the current one, the cost is recorded here and the label is left alone.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the shipped text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus voice card, the volume-04 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The section illustrates R-REGISTER-DICTION at the level of a whole formulation rather than a word: honored in the telling, ignored in the operation is the volume's own phrase for this failure and the generic paraphrase is from nowhere.

audits.auditor: editorial-agent, generation 1 of the twenty-rule re-render lane
audits.scope: Full re-read of the current section against the immutable baseline under all twenty rules. The original record was derived under the thirteen-rule index; this audit adds the substitution count and the later rules: R-LEDGER-WINS-COROLLARY, R-CORRECTION-SCOPE, R-CANON-DELETION-RECORD, R-PAIRED-DELETION, R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT, and R-REFRAIN-COST.

substitutionTest.rule: R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, substitution form, run as standing procedure before any pairing test
substitutionTest.method: Normalize both texts, strip markup, split into sentences of three or more words, count baseline sentences appearing verbatim in the current section.
substitutionTest.note: Well above zero, so the section is a restoration, not a substitution, and the pairing test applies. Verbatim survival understates fidelity here: every R-PUNCT-STRUCT repair and recorded bounding changes the sentence it lands in, so the non-surviving remainder was read against the diff and attributed rather than assumed lost.

audits.checked: R-CAUTIOUS-HALF: the accommodation argument keeps both its hedge and its committing two beat close, and the rotation example keeps the indispensability clause that gives it teeth. R-PAIRED-DELETION: drift, accommodation, and the constitutional-remedy test were swept; the remedy test's vocabulary recurs in the governance chapters with this section as its clearest statement. R-REGISTER-DICTION: the original record's regeneration note already treats the restored formulation, honored in the telling, ignored in the operation, as the register case, and the audit confirms it stands. R-CORRECTION-SCOPE, R-LEDGER-WINS-COROLLARY, R-TENSE, R-DEIXIS, R-NEGATION-STACK, R-REFRAIN-COST: nothing fires.
audits.conclusion: The restoration holds under the full twenty-rule index. Eighteen of twenty-nine baseline sentences survive verbatim; the remainder trace to two recorded punctuation repairs and the documented restorations. One substitution credit recorded as F3. No prose change required.
